description: One saved version of the presentation. It has a folder of its own under versions/, with this file and copies of the presentation's two files as they were saved. The `<time>` in its folder's name is when the version was saved, with its tail.

markdownpoint.description: The format version, as a major and a minor number in quotes: "1.0".

number.description: The number MarkdownPoint shows. It is one more than the highest version number when this version was saved.

name.description: The name the author gave the version. It is one line that isn't blank and has no control characters. Without it, the version has no name.
